description: This reference locates star-stator wound-rotor motor with rotor starter in Autodesk's IEEE-oriented 3 phase motors family. This representation distinguishes star-connected stator and a starter arrangement associated with the rotor circuit. The public library uses HMO1M5 for its horizontal representation; this is a vendor block name, not an IEEE standards symbol number.
